Tier (b) Playwright/Chromium: even the homepage failed with net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR / connection timeouts specifically for nykaafashion.com (verified general internet + other HTTPS/HTTP2 sites worked fine in the same Playwright session, e.g. google.com, wikipedia.org, and even nykaafashion.com/robots.txt over curl_cffi succeeded) - this is Akamai fingerprinting/rejecting the bundled Chromium's TLS/HTTP2 handshake, a genuine tier-b block. Moved to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome, which worked (200, full rendered content) for every URL tried. TREE METHOD: This is a fashion marketplace with a dedicated 'Home' vertical (nav link /home/c/8528). Built the tree from the union of (1) the desktop mega-menu (hover on 'Home' top-nav pill reveals a second-row nav strip: What's New, Sale, Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Bedding, Bath, Storage, Appliances, Floor Coverings, Accent Furniture... - hovering each of these opens a dropdown of clean canonical sub-category links with real hrefs, extracted via read_page/interactive) and (2) the in-page 'Category' left-rail filter widget on /home/c/8528 (shows the same tree as a nested drill-down list with live facet counts, useful for completeness-checking but its counts are FACET counts not page counts, so every qty actually recorded below was re-verified on the leaf's own dedicated listing page header, never taken from the facet panel). QTY METHOD: every recorded qty is the exact 'N items'/'N products' figure rendered in the H1 area of that leaf's own dedicated category page (confirmed via get_page_text after navigating directly to the canonical URL), never the facet-panel estimate and never aggregated/estimated. UI QUIRK: the site's own frontend intermittently and unpredictably re-rendered the same URL as either a desktop or a narrow/mobile-style layout across reloads within the same tab (not tied to any specific click), which repeatedly broke multi-step filter-panel drill-downs (CDP screenshots sometimes timed out during this re-render). Storage > Bins (298 items) - inspected actual product listing: these are trash cans/dustbins/pedal bins (waste disposal), NOT storage/organization containers per storage.md's primary-purpose test; excluded as a false keyword match. Storage > Lunch Essentials (355-679 items, count fluctuated live) - inspected actual product listing: tiffin boxes, bento boxes, lunch bags/kits - Kitchen & Dining/dining-accessory boundary, not organizational home storage; excluded. Kitchen & Dining as a whole not yet drilled beyond noting Table & Kitchen Linen exists (pending). Fillers (Bedding, 721 items) included as Textile - actual listing is pillows, cushion inserts, floor cushions, maternity/orthopaedic pillows, i.e. filled cushion/pillow products per textile.md Pillows & Cushions section, not raw stuffing material.
